question: Successive discounts of 9% and 6% are equivalent to a single discount of:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent single discount for successive discounts a% and b% = [a + b − (a × b) / 100]%

Here, a = 9% and b = 6%.

Equivalent discount = 9 + 6 − (9 × 6) / 100

Equivalent discount = 15 − 0.54 = 14.46%

**∴ The correct answer is 14.46%.**
